claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Troxipide is a non-cytotoxic gastric mucosal protectant that shows no appreciable antiproliferative activity at 2.5 uM; only its synthetic analogs or dye conjugates acquire cytotoxicity, so the parent compound is expected to be largely inactive.
